questions.q: Who came with his army against Jerusalem and attacked it?

questions.a: The city of Jerusalem was broken into.

questions.q: Who came and sat in the middle gate?
questions.a: All the officials of the king of Babylon came and sat in the middle gate.

questions.q: What did Zedekiah and all his fighting men do when they saw the officials of the king of Babylon in the middle gate?
questions.a: They fled at night from the city.

questions.q: What did the army of the Chaldeans (Babylonians) do when they caught up with Zedekiah?
questions.a: They captured him and brought him to Nebuchadnezzar.

questions.q: What did Nebuchadnezzar do when Zedekiah was brought to him?
questions.a: He slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons and also slaughtered all the noblemen of Judah.

questions.q: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah?
questions.a: He put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him so he could take Zedekiah to Babylon.

questions.q: What did the Chaldeans (Babylonians) do to the houses and walls of Jerusalem?
Whom did Nebuzaradan take into exile?
questions.a: He took into exile the rest of the people who were left in the city and the people who had deserted to the Chaldeans.

questions.q: What people did Nebuzaradan allow to stay in the land of Judah?
questions.a: He allowed the poorest people to remain.

questions.q: What did Nebuzaradan give to the people who remained?
questions.a: Nebuzaradan gave vineyards and fields to the people who remained.

questions.q: What did Nebuchadnezzar command Nebuzaradan to do about Jeremiah?
questions.a: Nebuchadnezzar told Nebuzaradan to take care of Jeremiah and to do anything Jeremiah told him to do.

questions.q: What did Nebuzaradan, Nergal Sharezer, and the most important officials of the king of Babylon do to Jeremiah?
questions.a: They took Jeremiah from the courtyard of the guard and entrusted him to Gedaliah to take Jeremiah home.

questions.q: What did Yahweh tell Jeremiah to say to Ebed Melech the Cushite?
questions.a: Yahweh told Jeremiah to say to Ebed Melech the Cushite that Yahweh was about to bring disaster on the city.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say would happen to Ebed Melech on the day that Yahweh carried out his words against the city?
questions.a: He said that he would rescue Ebed Melech.

questions.q: For what reason would Yahweh rescue Ebed Melech from the sword?
questions.a: He would rescue Ebed Melech because he trusted in Yahweh.

commentary.text: The taking of Jerusalem. (Jer. 39:1-10) Jeremiah used well. (Jer. 39:11-14) Promises of safety to Ebed-melech. (Jer. 39:15-18)

Jer. 39:1-10 Jerusalem was so strong, that the inhabitants believed the enemy could never enter it. But sin provoked God to withdraw his protection, and then it was as weak as other cities. Zedekiah had his eyes put out; so he was condemned to darkness who had shut his eyes against the clear light of God's word. Those who will not believe God's words, will be convinced by the event. Observe the wonderful changes of Providence, how uncertain are earthly possessions; and see the just dealings of Providence: but whether the Lord makes men poor or rich, nothing will profit them while they cleave to their sins.

Jer. 39:11-14 The servants of God alone are prepared for all events; and they are delivered and comforted, while the wicked suffer. They often meet with more kindness from the profane, than from hypocritical professors of godliness. The Lord will raise them up friends, do them good, and perform all his promises.

Jer. 39:15-18 Here is a message to assure Ebed-melech of a recompence for his great kindness to Jeremiah. Because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the Lord. God recompenses men's services according to their principles. Those who trust God in the way of duty, as this good man did, will find that their hope shall not fail in times of the greatest danger.
